# Attribution — Linear Ability Casting (Elemental Sandbox)

This `vendor/linear-ability/` tree is adapted from the MIT-licensed project:

- **Repository:** https://github.com/mohamedachrefelouafi/LinearAbiltyCastingThreeJS
- **Author:** mohamedachrefelouafi
- **License:** MIT (see `LICENSE` in this folder)

Only VFX-related sources were vendored (abilities, materials, effects, particles,
shaders, utils, assets, config, core). Character models, HUD/input, and the full
Vite app shell were omitted. Gallery demos drive abilities through
`gallery-bridge.js` with a stub environment (no App / CharacterController).

Original copyright notice is preserved in `LICENSE`.
